sections.title: Built for Galway's busy seasons — and available as Gaeilge
sections.dek: Festival weekends, the summer tourist run, race week — Galway call volume spikes when you're least able to answer. CallMeIE absorbs the surge 24/7, and for Gaeltacht-facing businesses it can greet, book and confirm entirely as Gaeilge.
sections.body: Galway runs on seasons. A salon in Salthill, a restaurant in the Latin Quarter, a garage in Oranmore or a practice in Knocknacarra gets hit with call spikes around the festivals, race week and the summer tourist run — exactly when the front desk is too busy to pick up. Every call that rings out in that window is a booking lost to the next business on Google. CallMeIE covers the line every hour of every day, absorbs the surge without putting anyone on hold, and texts back any caller it couldn't reach within a minute. Because Galway has a strong Gaeltacht, the system can also be configured to greet, book and confirm entirely as Gaeilge, or in a bilingual handover. Built and operated in-house from Limerick — no offshore call centre, caller data never sold on.

sections.title: What it handles for a Galway business
sections.dek: Six jobs, one system, working the hours and the surges a Galway front desk can't. Not a generic chatbot — a receptionist that happens to be software.
sections.body:
I — Answer

Answers every call, 24/7

Festival weekends, late nights, the summer rush — covered. Callers get a real conversation, not a voicemail beep, so they book instead of ringing a competitor.

II — Book

Books into your diary

Reads your Google Calendar live, quotes a real slot, confirms the appointment — no double-booking, no "we'll call you back".

III — Text back

Missed-call text-back (60s)

Any call that still rings out during a surge gets an SMS within a minute offering to book or answer a quick question. No Galway lead goes cold.

IV — Qualify

Takes the details that matter

Name, number, reason, urgency — captured every time and waiting for you, instead of a half-remembered note.

V — Escalate

Forwards the urgent ones

Genuinely urgent calls route straight to your mobile, with an SMS summary at the same time. You set the rules.

VI — Report

Monday morning summary

A plain email each Monday: calls taken, appointments booked, missed-call recoveries, top questions this week. Ninety seconds.
